pairwise_analysis_method.p_value_correction: Holm step-down family-wise correction across every pairwise condition comparison
pairwise_analysis_method.paired_ci: percentile paired bootstrap interval for the mean score difference, resampling matched episode pairs
pairwise_analysis_method.paired_test: two-sided paired sign-flip permutation test of the mean difference under within-pair exchangeability

astra_historical_4000_note.text: Astra's 4,000-episode local historical result includes an additional group 300. This matched comparison uses only groups 42, 100, and 200 (3,000 episodes). The paper's published 1,000-episode result is a separate sample and is not substituted here.

verified: Corrected raw episode summaries were independently recomputed from CSV data.
Preserved artifact hashes and selected replay traces were checked.
Corrected environment and policy streams use separate RNG instances.
limitations: Provider identities and some generation settings are recorded metadata, not independently authenticated.
The corrected 3,000-episode evaluation is a local reevaluation, not the paper's original 1,000-episode sample.
Six GUI tests failed and three errored at Tk startup; interactive desktop rendering was not verified.
One generation per model and one MinAtar environment do not establish general capability.
The browser arena uses a separate demonstration RNG and is not benchmark-equivalent.
